method: Independent read-only static source review and final run evidence spot checks; primary executed guarded runtime tests

findings.finding: Standalone archive could not prove audited export completion
findings.resolution: Protected post-completion attestation binds manifest, snapshot, completion receipt and publication checkpoint; later SQL marker binds attestation.

findings.finding: Rollover required authenticated continuity, not local head selection
findings.resolution: Retained generations, global sequence, previous transition/head/policy/key bindings, exact inventory and external expected-ancestor reference.

findings.finding: Reference head not constrained to declared generation
findings.resolution: Epoch range, rollover hash and head ancestry now checked; wrong generation/rollback/key/expiry tests.

findings.finding: Shallow restore phase checks could misreport missing prepared evidence
findings.resolution: Exact phase groups, UUID/schema/auth, intent/prepared/final hashes, source attestation and lineage validated before reporting.

findings.finding: Restore required exact reconstruction and exclusive durable publication
findings.resolution: Trusted schema/no archive SQL, strict ordered types/rowids, FULL transaction, integrity/logical/semantic checks, fsync, read-only inert artifact and RENAME_NOREPLACE.
Shared reentrant serialization; separate CLI requires exclusive existing journal lock.

findings.finding: Admitted rollover recovery could become stuck after permit expiry
findings.resolution: Continue exact durable original admission without new authorization; recovery receipt hash bound to commit; independent SIGKILL test.
Cross-linked phase records, source attestation markers, readiness and missing-phase negative tests.

findings.finding: Disaster and hostile archive coverage incomplete
findings.resolution: Page corruption, missing/duplicate/reordered content, HMAC/trust/policy errors, injected storage failures, paths/races,15 SIGKILL cases and UNKNOWN cancellation preservation.

findings.finding: Restore accepted legacy v1 despite documented lineage requirement
findings.resolution: Explicit v2 guard added; actual signed v1 remains inspectable but restore fails with restore_checkpoint_lineage_required.

findings.finding: Initial synthetic fixture violated guarded import/admission requirements
findings.resolution: Fenced synthetic historical batch preserves provenance; UNKNOWN created first; migration/admission capacity unchanged.

limitations: Local HMAC and custody do not defeat privileged/same-UID coordinated rollback or key compromise
Externally trusted reference provenance and time are required
SIGKILL is not physical power loss
Restored artifacts remain inert; future separately authorized re-anchor needed
No live/privileged or independent runtime test execution claimed
